BrochureContent.Content:
Located in the peaceful scenic townland of Sheskinarone on the outskirts of Dungloe Town, Campbells are delighted to present this charming cottage for sale to the open market as the ideal 
family / holiday home / rental property.

The property is situated on a slightly elevated, well manicured site boasting mature gardens and shrubbery as well as a generous outbuilding for additional storage needs. 

Internally, the property comes to the market in ready to occupy condition, comprising a spacious living room with open fireplace, fully fitted kitchen, main bathroom, a guest Bathroom and a W.C, and 4 generously sized Bedroom

In addition, there is a plot of land extending to approx. 1.0 acres adjacent to the cottage included in the sale

Viewing comes highly recommended and by STRICT appointment with Campbells Auctioneers.
